about_short_description.short_description: Developer of artificial intelligence powered software designed to automate medical insurance workflows.

product.name: CLARK
product.description: An AI-driven coding tool that converts encounter notes into medical codes for various claim types, ensuring compliance with coding standards.

product.name: CHLOE
product.description: An automated claims processor that validates and cleans claims in real time by cross-referencing EHR data, custom edits, and payer policies before submission.

product.name: DENNIS
product.description: An AI agent that analyzes denied claims, identifies root causes, edits claims, and generates appeal packets to resolve denials and improve accounts receivable.

product.name: ELLA
product.description: An automated eligibility and benefits verification system that updates patient insurance information and applies it to claims for accurate billing.

product.name: EVE
product.description: An AI solution that converts paper, PDF, or image Explanation of Benefits (EOB) documents into electronic remittance advice (ERA) for streamlined payment processing.

product.name: PAIGE
product.description: An AI-powered agent that automates high-volume payer phone calls for eligibility verification, denials management, and coverage inquiries with structured documentation.
